risk_factors.title: Risk Factors
risk_factors.content:
RISK FACTORS

Investment in equity shares involves a degree of risk. Investors should carefully read all risk factors 
before taking an investment decision. Additional risks not currently known may also materially impair 
the Company's business, financial condition, and results of operations.

**1. Limited Operating History Risk**
Test Pharma Ltd was incorporated on 2018-01-15. Our limited operating history makes it difficult to assess future performance.

**2. Sector-Specific Competition Risk**
The Pharmaceuticals sector is highly competitive. We face competition from larger, better-capitalised entities with greater market reach.

**3. Working Capital Risk**
Our business requires continuous working capital deployment. Delays in receivables or unforeseen capital requirements may impact liquidity.

**4. Key Personnel Risk**
Our success depends on senior management retention. Loss of key personnel may adversely affect our business.

**5. Regulatory Compliance Risk**
Our Pharmaceuticals business is subject to central and state government regulations. Changes in applicable laws could adversely impact operations.

**6. No Prior Public Market Risk**
There is no prior public market for our equity shares. The Issue price may not be indicative of the post-listing trading price.

**7. Promoter Lock-in Risk**
Promoter shares are subject to SEBI-mandated lock-in for 3 years. Post lock-in exit by promoters may create downward price pressure.

**8. General Economic Risk**
Our financial performance is linked to overall economic conditions in India and globally. Economic 
downturns, inflationary pressures, interest rate changes, and foreign exchange fluctuations could 
adversely affect our business.

**9. Geopolitical and Force Majeure Risk**
Unforeseen events including natural disasters, pandemics, geopolitical tensions, and social unrest 
could disrupt supply chains, reduce consumer demand, and adversely impact results.

Note: The above risk factors are based on information provided and general sector knowledge. 
Company-specific risk factors based on uploaded documents and detailed business information 
should be added by the legal team and merchant banker before filing.

business_overview.title: Business Overview
business_overview.content:
**BUSINESS OVERVIEW**

**Introduction**

Test Pharma Ltd, a company incorporated on January 15, 2018, under the Companies Act, 2013, with its registered office located at 123 MG Road, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400001, is a generic pharmaceutical manufacturer producing quality medicines for the domestic and export markets. Our company has over 6 years of operating history and serves hospitals, distributors, and retail chemists across 10 Indian states.

**Business Description**

We are engaged in the manufacture of generic pharmaceutical products, including tablets, capsules, and syrups. Our business operations are focused on providing affordable and high-quality medicines to our customers. We have a strong presence in the states of Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Rajasthan, with plans to expand our reach to other parts of the country.

**Products and Services**

Our key products include generic tablets, capsules, and syrups, which are manufactured at our facilities in accordance with international quality standards. We have obtained the ISO 9001:2015 certification, which demonstrates our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

**Geographical Presence**

Our products are currently sold in the states of Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Rajasthan. We plan to expand our geographical presence to other parts of the country, leveraging our strong distribution network and relationships with our customers.

**Management and Promoters**

Our company is led by a experienced management team, with Ramesh Kumar serving as the Managing Director and holding 55.0% of the equity share capital of the company. Sunita Kumar serves as a Director and holds 15.0% of the equity share capital of the company. Our management team has extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry and has played a key role in shaping our company's strategy and growth.

**Financial Performance**

Our financial performance for the last three fiscal years is as follows:

| Year | Revenue (INR Lakhs) | PAT (INR Lakhs) | EBITDA (INR Lakhs) | Total Assets (INR Lakhs) | Equity (INR Lakhs) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2021-22 | 1,200.50 | 85.30 | 142.00 | 950.20 | 420.10 |
| 2022-23 | 1,480.80 | 110.20 | 178.40 | 1,120.50 | 530.30 |
| 2023-24 | 1,820.30 | 142.70 | 220.50 | 1,350.80 | 660.00 |

**Issue Details**

We are proposing to issue [MISSING: number of equity shares] equity shares of face value INR 10 each, at a price band of INR 90 to INR 95 per equity share, aggregating to INR 25.00 Crore. The issue consists of a fresh issue of INR 20.00 Crore and an offer for sale of INR 5.00 Crore. The objects of the issue are:

1. Expansion of manufacturing capacity at our Pune plant: INR 12.00 Crore
2. Working capital requirements: INR 5.00 Crore
3. General corporate purposes: INR 3.00 Crore

The lead manager to the issue is XYZ Capital Advisors Pvt Ltd.

**Regulatory Compliance**

We have complied with all applicable regulatory requirements, including the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018. Our issue is being made in compliance with the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, and the rules and regulations framed thereunder.

**Auditors**

Our statutory auditor is ABC & Co. Chartered Accountants.

**XBRL Reporting**

Our financial data has been filed in XBRL (eXtensible Business Reporting Language) format, in accordance with the MCA-21 Extended Taxonomy.

**SEBI PRISM System**

Our offer document has been filed through the SEBI PRISM (Portal for Risk-based Internal Monitoring) system, as required by the SEBI regulations.

**Reservation in Issue**

In accordance with the SEBI ICDR Regulations, at least 50% of the net offer is reserved for retail individual investors, with the remaining net offer available to non-institutional investors and qualified institutional buyers. A specified portion is reserved for the market maker. The typical structure of the reservation is 50% for retail individual investors, with the remaining 50% available to non-institutional investors and qualified institutional buyers.

strategies.title: Business Strategies
strategies.content:
## Business Strategies

### Introduction
Test Pharma Ltd, a generic pharmaceutical manufacturer, has been operating in the domestic and export markets for over 6 years. Our business strategies are designed to leverage our strengths, capitalize on market opportunities, and drive growth.

### Key Business Strategies
Our key business strategies are as follows:

#### 1. Expansion of Manufacturing Capacity
We intend to utilize a portion of the proceeds from the Issue to expand our manufacturing capacity at our Pune Plant. This expansion will enable us to increase our production capacity, reduce costs, and improve our competitiveness in the market. The expansion is expected to be completed within [MISSING: timeframe] and will enable us to cater to the growing demand for our products.

#### 2. Enhancement of Product Portfolio
We plan to enhance our product portfolio by introducing new generic products, which will enable us to increase our market share and revenue. Our research and development team is continuously working on developing new products, which will be launched in the market after obtaining necessary regulatory approvals.

#### 3. Strengthening Distribution Network
We intend to strengthen our distribution network by appointing new distributors and increasing our presence in existing markets. This will enable us to increase our reach and availability of products to our customers.

#### 4. Focus on Quality and Regulatory Compliance
We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of quality and regulatory compliance. We have obtained ISO 9001:2015 certification, which demonstrates our commitment to quality. We will continue to invest in our quality control systems and processes to ensure that our products meet the required standards.

#### 5. Increasing Exports
We plan to increase our exports to new markets, which will enable us to diversify our revenue streams and reduce our dependence on the domestic market. We are exploring new markets and are in the process of obtaining necessary regulatory approvals.

### Competitive Strategy
Our competitive strategy is based on the following key elements:

* **Quality**: We are committed to delivering high-quality products that meet the required standards.
* **Price**: We offer competitive pricing, which enables us to compete with other players in the market.
* **Service**: We provide excellent customer service, which enables us to build strong relationships with our customers.

### Risk Management
We have identified certain risks that may impact our business, including [MISSING: specific risks]. We have implemented risk management strategies to mitigate these risks, including [MISSING: risk mitigation strategies].

### Growth Plan
Our growth plan is based on the following key elements:

* **Organic Growth**: We plan to achieve organic growth by increasing our sales and revenue.
* **Inorganic Growth**: We may consider inorganic growth opportunities, such as acquisitions or partnerships, to expand our business.

### Conclusion
Our business strategies are designed to drive growth, increase revenue, and improve our competitiveness in the market. We are committed to delivering high-quality products, providing excellent customer service, and maintaining the highest standards of quality and regulatory compliance.

dividend_policy.title: Dividend Policy
dividend_policy.content:
DIVIDEND POLICY

Test Pharma Ltd has not declared any dividends in the past. The Board of Directors may recommend dividends in the future, subject to the profits available for distribution, after considering the Company's growth plans, future capital requirements, financial condition, and applicable legal requirements. Any future declaration of dividends will require the approval of the shareholders of the Company at the Annual General Meeting and will be at the discretion of the Board.

There is no guarantee that dividends will be declared or paid in any financial year. Any dividends paid 
in the future will be subject to applicable laws and regulations, including Companies Act 2013, and will 
be recommended by the Board of Directors from time to time.

Investors should note that past financial performance, including past dividend payments (if any), is not 
indicative of future results.
